# MUXARO

> MUXARO is a high-performance, ad-free creator media processing workspace and sovereign stream utility. Engineered with Next.js 14, Fastify 5, and FFmpeg, MUXARO enables lossless stream-copy remuxing (`-c copy`), 8K/4K DASH video-audio multiplexing, bitstream audio extraction (FLAC, MP3, Opus), format conversion, and multi-item batch processing up to 4 GB per file with zero ads, zero user tracking, and automatic 60-minute ephemeral file deletion.

## Core Media Tools

- [/ (Workspace Home)](https://muxaro.app/): Omnibox media processing engine for instant URL stream inspection, direct downloading, format conversion, and local file uploads up to 4 GB.
- [/tools/media-converter](https://muxaro.app/tools/media-converter): Universal audio and video container converter supporting MP4, MKV, WebM, MOV, MP3, FLAC, and WAV with automatic lossless stream copying when codecs match.
- [/tools/audio-extractor](https://muxaro.app/tools/audio-extractor): Bitstream audio demuxer extracting original soundtrack streams (AAC, Opus) without re-encoding, or transcoding to studio-grade FLAC (24-bit), WAV, or 320 kbps MP3.
- [/tools/audio-video-merger](https://muxaro.app/tools/audio-video-merger): Multiplexer for combining disjoint high-resolution video streams (DASH 4K/8K) with separate audio tracks, featuring millisecond timestamp synchronization.
- [/tools/video-merger](https://muxaro.app/tools/video-merger): Frame-accurate video clip concatenator joining multiple recordings into a unified MP4 or MKV container with PTS/DTS timeline normalization.
- [/tools/batch-processing](https://muxaro.app/tools/batch-processing): Multi-URL batch processor allowing parallel queueing and tailored output configurations for creator workflows.
- [/tools/playlist-processing](https://muxaro.app/tools/playlist-processing): Authorized playlist processor handling up to 50 items with automated ZIP archive packaging and zero-padded item indexing.
- [/credits](https://muxaro.app/credits): Real-time quota dashboard tracking rolling 24-hour job allowances (10 single jobs, 1 playlist job per 24 hours).
- [/docs](https://muxaro.app/docs): Technical documentation covering audio quality, container specifications, video resolutions, and ephemeral security guarantees.

## Supported Platforms & Input Streams

- **YouTube**: Innertube multi-client resolution (IOS, Android, TV, Web) extracting progressive MP4 (360p–720p) and disjoint adaptive DASH video streams up to 8K (4320p, 60fps, HDR) paired with high-bitrate Opus/AAC audio tracks.
- **TikTok**: Direct extraction of non-watermarked high-definition video (`play_addr`) via SSR hydration JSON parsing.
- **Instagram**: Reels, Video Posts, and Carousel video extraction via authenticated GraphQL queries.
- **Twitter / X**: Progressive MP4 multi-bitrate resolution via Twitter GraphQL endpoints.
- **Direct HTTP/HTTPS**: Any direct media stream or remote file URL with full RFC 9110 HTTP Range header resumption.
- **Local File Uploads**: Single-stream and chunked multipart uploads up to 4 GB per media item.

## Key Operational Rules & Constraints

- **Zero-Ad Policy**: MUXARO serves 0 display ads, 0 pop-up windows, 0 pop-under redirects, and 0 third-party trackers.
- **4 GB Free File Size Limit**: All users can process single media files or playlist items up to 4 GB with no subscription required.
- **Lossless Stream-Copy Remuxing**: When input codecs are compatible with output containers (e.g. H.264/AAC to MP4 or VP9/Opus to MKV/WebM), MUXARO executes `-c copy` stream demuxing in under 1 second with 0% generational re-encoding loss.
- **DASH Video-Audio Multiplexing**: Automatically merges disjoint 1080p, 1440p, 4K, and 8K adaptive video tracks with original audio tracks into a playable MP4 or MKV container.
- **Ephemeral Zero-Retention Privacy**: Uploaded media and processed output artifacts expire and are permanently wiped from disk and storage buckets after exactly 60 minutes.
- **Daily Rolling Allowances**: Free guest and registered tiers receive 10 single media processing jobs and 1 batch playlist job (up to 50 items) per rolling 24-hour window, with atomic quota reservation rollbacks on cancelled or failed jobs.
- **Signed Download Artifacts**: Download links are protected by HMAC-SHA256 expiration tokens, verifying artifact integrity and preventing unauthorized URL enumeration.
